text: Artificial intelligence is changing the world, but its growth brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias. AI systems learn from data, and if that data contains unfair patterns, the AI can make biased decisions, for example, rejecting loans based on race or gender. Fairness requires us to check and correct these mistakes. Privacy is also key, since AI often collects large amounts of personal information. Transparency means people should understand why an AI makes a certain choice, not receive a mysterious answer. Finally, responsible AI development means that companies, governments, and engineers must work together to create rules that protect users. Ethics is not an obstacle—it is a necessary guide to make AI safe and trustworthy for everyone.
